title: Initial control-plane parameters
problem: The specification leaves numeric limits to the Manager.
rationale: Backpressure: maxActiveTasks 10, maxTasksPerWorker 1, heavy builds WINDOWS 3 / WSL 3 / ANY 5, maxActiveReservations 40, maxQueuedTasks 500, maxMergeQueueItems 50. Anti-thrash freeze thresholds: reassign 3, recovery 2, CI retry 3, reservation conflict 3, scope correction 3. Lease TTL/max: TASK_ASSIGNMENT 3600s/86400s, RESERVATION 7200s/172800s (not worker-renewable), MERGE_AUTHORIZATION 900s (not renewable), EXTERNAL_EXECUTION 1800s/21600s. Timing: claim ack 900s; heartbeat stale 600s, lost-candidate 1800s (never automatic LOST); all polling at most 1000ms. Aging +1 per 24h or 3 deferrals, max +3; starvation alert at 72h or 5 deferrals. Changes require a superseding decision.
